meta.title: Journal filter
meta.description: Adds a 期刊筛选 action at the sidebar foot, beside Settings. It opens a panel over the app that filters the bundled 2025 CAS journal table (21,772 titles) by major category (21) and minor category (254, searchable, multi-select), impact factor range (2024 JCR, 20,872 titles), 2025 quartile, change since 2023, Top, open access, WoS index (SCIE/SSCI/ESCI/AHCI), and journal-name keywords. Minor categories narrow to the selected major category, so picking 社会学 then 法学 yields the 427 law titles. Type a requirement in the top box (`材料 2区以上 IF>5 非OA 升级`, `小类:法学 2区以上`) and press Enter, or click the chips; sort by impact factor (the column header toggles its direction), quartile, change or name, and export CSV with impact factor, major category, minor categories and WoS index columns. Everything runs on the local table the bundle ships: no model requests, no network access, no writes beyond the CSV download. Impact factors are Clarivate JCR 2024; titles without a JCR record show `—` and are excluded once a bound is set. Turning the bundle off removes the action, the panel, and the table route.
